§M{m001:MiddlewareAfter}
  §F{f001:RunTwice:pub}<eff e> (Func<i32>:g §E{e}) -> i32
    §E{e}
    §B{first:i32} §C{g}
    §R first

  §F{f002:Beat:pub} () -> i32
    §E{cw}
    §P "beat"
    §R INT:1

  §CL{c000:BehaviorBase:pub}
    §FLD{Func<i32>:stageBase:pro} §E{cw}

  §CL{c001:RetryBehavior:BehaviorBase:pub}
    §MT{mt003:Twice:pub} () -> i32
      §E{}
      §R §C{RunTwice} §A stageBase §/C
